title: Large fringe trees for random trees with given vertex degrees
summary: This paper extends the study of fringe trees in random plane trees with a given degree statistic. While previous work established the asymptotic normality of the count of fringe trees isomorphic to a fixed tree, we investigate the case where the target tree grows with the size of the random tree. We consider three primary subtree counts: the number of fringe trees isomorphic to a specific growing tree, the number of fringe trees sharing a given growing degree statistic, and the number of fringe trees of a specific growing size.
